dataset: Official Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025 published aggregate chart data
original_format: Nested JSON by question, audience segment, and response option

profile_before_normalization.data_level: published aggregate responses, not person-level rows

cleaning_applied: Selected 11 relevant questions and their audience segments with adequate published data.
Removed HTML formatting and collapsed whitespace in question and answer labels.
Validated numerical response counts and fractions; excluded invalid, negative and out-of-range values.
Checked response label uniqueness within each question and segment.
Converted fraction percentages to 0-100 units rounded to two decimal places.
Kept a separate respondent denominator for each question and segment.
Created normalized JSON for interactive dashboard and 795-row tidy CSV for analysis.
analytical_caveats: 2025 is a single cross-sectional survey snapshot. It cannot establish a time trend.
Respondents are self-selected, so results do not represent a random sample of all software developers.
Question denominators vary; do not equate values across questions with individual behavior.
Multi-select responses are not mutually exclusive and percentages can sum above 100.
Some questions publish only a subset of categories. Do not force shown percentages to sum to 100.
This dataset contains official aggregates, so individual-level cross-tabulations cannot be computed.
